reviews.title: Keeps the CPU cool, runs quiet, and is reliable.
reviews.comment: Used in a gaming rig for well over a year now, keeps the CPU nice and cool. Keep the fan clean, use a good thermal paste, and it'll meet all of your expectations. Cooler Master makes great quality units, that last.
reviews.author: Raider1911

reviews.title: Affordable classic CPU cooler
reviews.comment: I've bought several Cooler Master Hyper 212 CPU coolers over nearly 2 decades(!!) and they have all performed well in their intended roles. For a casual Core i3/i5 PC, this cooler keeps the CPU sufficiently cool and is much quieter than the stock Intel fans. This cooler is not too big and fits in every Micro-ATX and Full ATX case I've ever owned.
reviews.author: LZ

reviews.title: Great CPU cooler at a low cost
reviews.comment:
For the price of this cooler being only about $15-$20, it is amazing and has RGB lighting if you want that.
I used this cooler with a Ryzen 7 5800X and it worked very well and looks great.
reviews.author: Andrew G

reviews.title: Tried and true
reviews.comment: This cooler was incredibly easy to install onto my motherboard and does a great job of keeping things nice and cool. It's not too loud, the included fan isn't blazingly bright, and is overall a very sleek and useful cooler. One thing I will note to everyone is to be extra careful to not bend any argb pins on your board while installing this or any other kind of fan (Speaking from experience.)
reviews.author: Ben

reviews.title: Decent cooler
reviews.comment:
This cooler has very low noise honestly with the case doors on I can tune it out ,  the size is pretty big which brings concerns of it causing extra damage to the motherboard in the event you ever drop your computer ,  the weight of this cooler and it being top heavy might cause it to bend pins but just avoid dropping your computer in the first place of course.
The cooling capacity is great from my experience running it in a hot room and it keeps my computer within good operating temperatures.
The ease of installation is a little bit impeded by the size of the cooler being so large ,  on smaller motherboards it can make removing/replacing ram a hassle , but that's potentially a non issue if you just install the cooler last.
I'd say its a good value for the money and does the job its meant to do,  there are smaller coolers that work just as well without the hassle of working with something this big.
reviews.author: Dundee Anderson
